items.title: Walk into every customer meeting knowing what you promised
items.summary: Find the commitment, prepare for the conversation, and follow through with the right information. You have a customer review coming up. Before you join, you need to know what the customer expects, what the team has finished, and which decisions are still open. The invitation is in Google Calendar.
